'''Marc Edward Culler''' (born November 22, 1953) is an American mathematician who works in [[geometric group theory]] and [[low-dimensional topology]]. A native Californian, Culler did his undergraduate work at the [[University of California at Santa Barbara]] and his graduate work at [[University of California, Berkeley|Berkeley]] where he graduated in 1978. He is now a [[professor emeritus]] at the [[University of Illinois at Chicago]].  Culler is the son of [[Glen Culler|Glen Jacob Culler]] who was an important early innovator in the development of the Internet.

==Work==
Culler specializes in [[group theory]],<ref>[http://www.math.ucsb.edu/~jon.mccammond/geogrouptheory/people.html People in Geometric Group Theory]</ref> low dimensional topology, [[3-manifolds]], and [[hyperbolic geometry]]. Culler frequently collaborates with [[Peter Shalen]] and they have co-authored many papers.<ref>Culler, Marc; Shalen, Peter B. Varieties of group representations and splittings of 3-manifolds. Ann. of Math. (2) 117 (1983), no. 1, 109–146.</ref><ref>Culler, Marc; Gordon, C. McA.; Luecke, J.; Shalen, Peter B. Dehn surgery on knots. Ann. of Math. (2) 125 (1987), no. 2, 237–300</ref>  Culler and Shalen did joint work that related properties of representation varieties of [[hyperbolic 3-manifold]] groups to decompositions of 3-manifolds.  In particular, Culler and Shalen used the [[Bass–Serre theory]], applied to the function field of the SL(2,C)-[[Character variety]] of a 3-manifold, to obtain information about
[[incompressible surface]]s in the manifold.  Based on this work, Shalen, [[Cameron Gordon (mathematician)|Cameron Gordon]], [[John Edwin Luecke|John Luecke]], and Culler proved the [[cyclic surgery theorem]].

Another important contribution by Culler came in a 1986 paper with [[Karen Vogtmann]] called "Moduli of graphs and automorphisms of free groups".<ref name="CV86">{{Citation | last = Culler | first = Marc |author2=Vogtmann, Karen | title = Moduli of graphs and automorphisms of free groups | journal = [[Inventiones Mathematicae]] | volume = 84 | issue = 1 | pages = 91–119 | year=1986 | url=https://www.math.cornell.edu/~vogtmann/ScannedPapers/1986.0084.pdf | doi = 10.1007/BF01388734 | bibcode = 1986InMat..84...91C | s2cid = 122869546 | postscript = .}}</ref> This paper introduced an object that came to be known as [[Out(Fn)#Outer space|Culler&ndash;Vogtmann Outer space]].

Culler is one of the authors of a 1994 paper called "Plane curves associated to character varieties of 3-manifolds"<ref>D. Cooper, M. Culler, H. Gillet, D. D. Long and P. B. Shalen.  Plane curves associated to character varieties of 3-manifolds.  Invent. Math., 118(1):47--84, 1994.</ref> which introduced the A-polynomial of a knot<ref>[http://www.evri.com/media/article;jsessionid=x8dlxkdrd423?title=Knot+Table:+A-Polynomial+-+Indiana+University&page=http://www.indiana.edu/~knotinfo/descriptions/a_polynomial.html&referring_uri=/person/marc-culler-0x57c4b9%3Bjsessionid%3Dx8dlxkdrd423&referring_title=Evri The A-polynomial and the FFT], in PDF format</ref> or, more generally, of a 3-manifold with one torus boundary component.

Culler is an editor of ''[[The New York Journal of Mathematics]]''.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/19980128023114/http://emis.math.ecnu.edu.cn/journals/NYJM/Edboard.html|title=New York Journal of Mathematics}}</ref> He was a [[Sloan Foundation]] Research Fellow<ref>{{cite news|newspaper=[[The New York Times]]|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1986/03/09/nyregion/90-scientists-win-research-grants.html|title=90 Scientists Win Research Grants|date=March 9, 1986|access-date=2024-04-11}}</ref> (1986–1988) and a UIC University Scholar<ref>[http://www.uic.edu/htbin/cgiwrap/bin/uicnews/articledetail.cgi?id=12357 UIC News: 2008 University Scholar Marc Culler]</ref><ref name="UIC College awards">[http://www.math.uic.edu/awards UIC College awards]</ref> (2008). In 2014, he became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>

==Selected publications==
* Culler, Marc; Shalen, Peter B.; ''Varieties of group representations and splittings of 3-manifolds.'' [[Annals of Mathematics]]. (2) 117 (1983), no. 1, 109–146.
* Culler, Marc; Gordon, C. McA.; Luecke, J.; Shalen, Peter B. ''Dehn surgery on knots.''  Annals of Mathematics (2)  125  (1987),  no. 2, 237–300.
* Marc Culler and Karen Vogtmann;  ''A group-theoretic criterion for property'' A.  Proc. Amer. Math. Soc., 124(3):677—683, 1996. {{MR|1307506}}
